question: When names are chosen only from information knowable at the signal close, do 6- and 12-month net-of-cost, benchmark-relative, risk-adjusted results improve?
frozenBefore: every forward price read by evaluate.py; features.py reads only values knowable at the signal close
exposureStatement: The pilot (2023-04..2026-09) results, #329/#343 Korean results and #344 Top-K results were seen before this design. This is exploratory measurement on exposed history, never confirmation, promotion or a production change.

inputs.prices: replay-v16 at signal-history 704d7db6 via scripts/run_us_decision_pilot.load_prices (forward total-return index, through 2026-09-14)
inputs.filings: ledger/fundamentals/us at 704d7db6 via load_filings (Finnhub financials-reported, visibility max(availableFrom, acceptedDate) strictly before the signal date)

benchmarks.secondary: QQQ total return (replay close, +0.38824 USD 2020-09-21 distribution applied once per docs/us-readiness/us-qqq-distribution-correction-v1.json)

inputs.asTraded: Yahoo split-adjusted close x later split ratios, outside git; identity-checked against the replay series

signal.dates: last US session of each completed week 2013-01..2026-09-14
signal.exitFixedHolding: entry index + H sessions, H in {126, 252}

universe.member: S&P 500 member on the latest membership snapshot on or before the signal date; pilot identity holds (ticker reuse, malformed symbols, renames) inherited
universe.common: non-Financials, non-Real-Estate, priced with 253 exact sessions, identity admitted (MEMBERSHIP_CIK where the snapshot carries a CIK, else PIT_SINGLE_CIK), the pilot's four accounting fields fresh (report age <= 180 days), net income TTM, OCF TTM, prior-year OCF TTM and market cap proxy present
universe.survivorship: names the replay never priced (departed issuers) are absent; SPY-relative results before 2023 are survivor-conditioned (biased upward); peer-relative selection compares names inside the same survivor-conditioned universe

strategies.PRICE: pilot B1: mean rank of 252-session momentum and low 252-session volatility
strategies.SECTOR_MOMENTUM_BASKET: sector with the highest equal-weight mean 252-session momentum of its common-universe members; hold all its common-universe members equally
strategies.WITHIN_SECTOR_VALUE: mean of within-sector percentile ranks of earnings yield (net income TTM / market cap) and book yield (equity / market cap; negative equity ranks lowest by value)
strategies.CASH_PROFITABILITY: within-sector percentile rank of cash operating profitability (OCF TTM / assets)
strategies.VALUE_CONFIRMED: WITHIN_SECTOR_VALUE among names with net income TTM > 0, OCF TTM > 0 and OCF TTM > prior-year OCF TTM (Korean S2 three signs); others ineligible
strategies.PRICE_CONFIRMED: PRICE among the same confirmed names (adds the confirmation filter to the price signal)
strategies.B2_MULTIFACTOR: pilot B2: equal weight of price, cash, accrual, investment and leverage families

books.TOP5: top 5 by score, at most 2 per sector, equal weight (SECTOR_MOMENTUM_BASKET: the basket itself)
books.TOP_QUINTILE: top ceil(N/5) by score, equal weight (the pilot's broad book)

costs: pipeline.benchmark_alpha.REALISTIC_COSTS['US']: buy 8.0 bp, sell 8.3 bp; the same rates are charged to SPY and QQQ at entry and exit

fixedHolding.return: equal-weight mean of name returns entry->exit minus buy and sell cost
fixedHolding.missingExit: a held name without an exit close leaves that cohort UNRESOLVED for that strategy; no substitution, no zero, no last price

attribution.peerSelection: mean over held names of r_i - R(same sector, same within-sector market-cap tercile, common universe, EW)

fixedHolding.statistics: mean, median, win rate, 10th percentile; moving-block bootstrap of the weekly cohort series (block H/5 weeks, 2000 draws, seed 20261115); greedy non-overlapping cohort count reported

rebalancingNav: four equal-capital accounts, account k trades on signal weeks k, k+4, ... (entry next session), summed NAV, costs via pipeline.us_decision_pilot.simulate; CAGR, volatility, tracking error and information ratio vs SPY, MDD, turnover, yearly contribution
priceVsFinancial: B2_MULTIFACTOR - PRICE, VALUE_CONFIRMED - WITHIN_SECTOR_VALUE and PRICE_CONFIRMED - PRICE, paired on cohorts where both are resolved

concentrationControls.TOPK_CAP: Top 5/10/100 by market cap proxy among all priced members with a cap (financials included), cap- and equal-weighted, fixed holding vs SPY
concentrationControls.officialTop10Index: S&P 500 Top 10 index levels: SOURCE_BLOCKED in this environment (HTTP 403); research/us_rank_independent_check_v1/crosscheck.external_index_segments splits back-test and live when a person supplies the export

aiCapex.spenders: the 10 largest capex TTM spenders in Information Technology, Communication Services and Consumer Discretionary on the signal date (filing-visible)
aiCapex.spenderCapexGrowth: sum capex TTM / sum prior-year capex TTM - 1 over those spenders
aiCapex.regime: HIGH when that growth exceeds its own expanding median over earlier signal dates (minimum 52)
aiCapex.suppliers: no point-in-time supplier relationship or sub-industry field exists here; the Information Technology sector basket (common universe) is used as a labelled PROXY, not as identified suppliers
aiCapex.readings: spender basket and IT-proxy basket fixed-holding excess vs SPY by regime

forbidden: choosing a strategy, period, book or threshold after reading a result
imputing a missing price or accounting field
pooling SPY-relative results across the survivorship break without the label
